item.title: 'Mostly underneath the couch cushion': 2-month-old girl died after her mother fell asleep with the child in her arms, cops say
item.description: A woman in Indiana is accused of causing her 2-month-old daughter's death by falling asleep on the couch with the child in her arms, causing the baby to become wedged underneath a cushion and suffocate.
